data.summary_en: EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agent framework, uses fast–slow dual systems to maintain code and skill hypotheses in a Hypothesis Graph; Value-of-Information Experiment Selection picks distinguishing physical experiments to drive code–skill co-evolution. It reaches 77.0% overall success rate on RoboCasa365 and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen; best baseline: 40.1%.
